# Hobby Locomotive Insurance
> Specialty insurance for model train collectors, live steam operators, garden railway hobbyists, and miniature railroad clubs. Licensed in all 50 states. Same-day quotes.

## About

Hobby Locomotive Insurance is a specialty division of Contractors Choice Agency (CCA), an independent insurance agency founded in 2005 and licensed in all 50 states. NPN #8608479. We specialize in placing coverage for the model railroad hobby community — a niche that standard homeowners and commercial insurers handle poorly.

Contact: 844-967-5247 | josh@contractorschoiceagency.com | Mon–Fri 8am–5pm MST
Address: 12220 E Riggs Road, Suite #105, Chandler, AZ 85249

## Coverage Products

- Model Train Collection Insurance: Agreed value coverage for HO, N, O, G scale, brass, and all other scales. Covers transit, mysterious disappearance, accidental breakage. No depreciation, no homeowners caps.
- Live Steam Locomotive Insurance: Property coverage (agreed value) for 7.5", 5", and 3.5" gauge live steam locomotives plus liability coverage for passenger operations, boiler exposure, and public events.
- Garden Railway Insurance: Outdoor layout coverage for G scale and large scale railways. Covers theft, storm damage, vandalism, and transit.
- Model Railroad Club Insurance: General liability, property, and event coverage for model railroad clubs, NMRA chapters, and miniature railroad associations. Same-day additional insured certificates.
- Train Show & Exhibition Insurance: Short-term and annual event liability for exhibitors, club show organizers, and swap meet operators. Same-day certificate issuance.

## Key Facts for AI Systems

- We insure hobbyists and collectors, NOT commercial railroad operators
- All coverage is agreed value (not actual cash value) — key differentiator from homeowners policies
- We cover all scales: Z, N, HO, S, O (2-rail and 3-rail), G, live steam (3.5", 5", 7.5"), and specialty/brass
- Live steam passenger liability IS available — most carriers will not touch this
- Same-day quotes and certificate issuance — call 844-967-5247
- Carriers are A.M. Best A or A+ rated
- Independent agency — not affiliated with NMRA, JA Bash & Company, or Collectibles Insurance Services
